suggestions.observation: EBP isolates idiosyncratic credit supply channel, cleaner IV than raw HY-IG spread.
suggestions.rationale: EBP has stronger predictive content per Gilchrist & Zakrajšek (2012).
suggestions.possible_use_case: IV specification or alternative signal family
suggestions.caveats: Requires bond-level data or direct download from Fed research page.
suggestions.notes: Noted in spec memo as preferred IV candidate.

suggestions.signal_name: Rate-shock control variable (10yr Treasury yield change)
suggestions.observation: 2022 inflation episode confounds HY-IG signal (rate-driven, not credit-cycle). Adding yield change as control could improve signal specificity.
suggestions.rationale: Spec memo §4 flags rate-shock confounding as key pitfall.
suggestions.caveats: Increases complexity; may overfit on 354-month sample.
